![Aran's booth at phone width, showing three sections](data:image/png;base64,)

Three sections instead of two, in his queue's own order:

| | Section | Lines | State |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **POD-1** | 80 | 78 recorded · 2 still to read |
| 2 | **SENEDD** | 384 | 1 recorded · 383 still to read |
| 3 | **NEW SEEDS** | 305 | 89 recorded · 216 still to read |

Before tonight the first two were one section headed **POD-1, 464 lines, 79 recorded**

Each section carries its own grid of marks, so "the conversations are done and the

Once he taps Start, the line he is reading says which body it belongs to.
